name: std::chrono::tzdb_list::front
intro: Obtains a reference to the first std::chrono::tzdb in the list. Simultaneous calls to this function and std::chrono::reload_tzdb() does not introduce a data race.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the first std::chrono::tzdb in the list.
